Thank you for downloading Rounded Screen Corners!


INSTALLATION:
You have two ways to install:

1. Easy install (recommended)
   Right-click RoundedScreenCorners_Installer.bat and choose "Run as administrator".
   It will:
     - Trust the Rounded Screen Corners signing certificate (one-time, system-wide)
     - Install the .msixbundle package
     - Launch the app

   You only need to trust the certificate once -- future updates from this
   same channel reuse it.

2. Manual install
   a. Open SystemFiles\RoundedScreenCorners_*.cer, click "Install Certificate...",
      choose "Local Machine", and place it in "Trusted Root Certification
      Authorities".
   b. Double-click SystemFiles\RoundedScreenCorners_*.msixbundle and press "Install"
      in the App Installer dialog.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Note: GitHub releases provide the full feature set without restrictions. Updates must be
installed manually. For one-click installation and automatic updates, use the Microsoft Store
version: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9N9XMSJZDTSC
